paragraphs: Ravin bar Kahana before Rabbi, Jerusalem Talmud, Pesachim, beginning of chapter 3—requires examination. He asked Rabbi Ila, Bikkurim, chapter 1, halakhah 8. Avin bar Chiyya asked him. He asked Rabbi Immi, beginning of Shor Shenagach et Happarah. Rabbi Zeira asked him, Zevachim 105b. Rabbi Mana asked him; Rabbi Mani bar Yonah asked him. Rabbi Yehoshua bar Zeidal and Rabbi Chananyah went up to Rabbi Yannai. Rabbi Redifa, Rabbi Acha in Ravin’s name, beginning of Metzi'at Ha'ishah. Shekalim, chapter 2, halakhah 5: Rav Bibi b.K.; the Jerusalem Talmud reads Rabbi Bon b.K. Rabbi Bon b.K. asked Rabbi Ammi, father of Rabbi Avdimi of Sepphoris.
